description:
As an HR Manager, fully onboard a new hire into TimeTrex. The new employee is Robert Nakamura (employee number EM-ON001), who is already added to the system. Complete three onboarding steps:

1. Set his hourly wage to $19.50, with an effective date of February 1, 2026.
2. Create his work schedule for the week of March 9-13, 2026 (Monday through Friday), from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM each day.
3. Create his work schedule for the week of March 16-20, 2026 (Monday through Friday), from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM each day.

All three steps must be completed for full credit. Robert Nakamura has no existing wage or schedule records.
